title: Project SND: Pre-registration Protocol V2.0.12 and Reference Implementation (randomization test + Feldman-Cousins-Rice upper confidence bound)
description:
Pre-registration protocol (V2.0.12) for a statistical test of whether a sealed feature x is dependent on a later, randomly assigned basis angle theta. The test is a block-randomization test (exact under the stated randomization design) together with a one-sided Feldman-Cousins-Rice upper confidence bound for the amplitude.

Contents: protocol text (V2.0.12 and history V2.0.01-V2.0.11), audit records with claim labels (proved / numerically supported / unverified), a tested Python reference implementation, reduced-scale validation results, and original exploratory scripts with known-issue notes.

Status: NO real experimental data exist or are included; all numerical results are reduced-scale simulations. Open issues (listed in the protocol and audit) include a counter-example class of hardware bias that centring cannot remove, unverified full-scale CLT for the alternative, unverified achievability of the required feature variance, and an unmeasured GPU budget.
